differences: The paper reports 12 severe-CBL patients in the 2013 study (20 in total); the 2013 file has 13 patient columns but only 12 ICARS scores, so one patient column has no ICARS score and the paper's patient count does not reproduce exactly. All columns are kept and grouped as the authors grouped them (group severe_CBL = field p).
One milder-CBL participant of the 2010 study has no abrupt-session data at all (every value empty); that empty sequence is not written.
The initial deflections of the first abrupt field trial match the paper within about 0.5 deg (the paper's exact baseline correction is not given), so a tolerance of 1 deg is used.
